vehicle.scope: This checkout and these sessions only; not a universal Alfa Romeo or cross-model DBC.

byte_convention: Zero-based byte indexes; bit 0 is LSB. Parts are concatenated in listed most-significant-first order; physical = raw * scale + offset.
capture_limits: RX capture only; own firmware TX is not recorded.
No IDE/RTR flag in binary records; do not infer these flags from a shared numeric ID.
Host timestamps are receipt times and batch across USB; board clocks have no common epoch.
Startup loss counts can saturate at 65535.
Frame presence or firmware implementation is not independent physical validation.

messages.title: IPC text fragments
messages.note: Transport length is last index + 1. Source context is the last observed text context, not a guaranteed live audio-source selector. UTF-16BE-compatible packing; IPC glyph/surrogate support is not established. The MY23 UI candidate transmits selected BMP glyphs as 16 padded characters, CR, 22 padded characters (13 fragments); legacy remains variable-length L1 plus its footer. Factory text field lengths remain variable. These captured sessions contain RX, not this candidate's BH TX, so they do not prove its visible alignment. Current firmware defaults to immutable complete screen passes (Full); RAM-only Delta retains changed-fragment transmission. Menu fragment pacing is 20 ms by default (owner-reported stable vehicle test), with temporary 50/10 ms choices and a five-second BH lease for nondefault options; expiry restores 20 ms Full. These implementation options do not change the frame bit layout or establish timing/visibility in historical RX captures.

messages.title: DNA selector momentary direction

signals.name: dna_selector_direction
signals.note: Supported by all 36 directional pulses in three sessions: eight N-to-D transitions follow raw byte 0=40 by 108-112 ms on BH; reverse direction uses 20. These are transient inputs, not selected-mode codes. Raw 3 is unobserved and remains unnamed. Source ECU identity and successful replay remain unverified. See docs/research/20261023-dna-all-sessions.md.

signals.name: suspension_button
signals.note: 18 D pulses alternate suspension calibration in 20261010-111025Z; an additional N pulse has no calibration change. Source ECU and replay acceptance are not established. See docs/research/20261024-startup-audit.md. New labelled matrix: 12 button pulses, four N/A controls without calibration change, four D toggles and four Race toggles. Eight changes follow the input by 25–45 ms on BH. docs/research/20261024-three-session-audit.md

messages.note: BH-only DLC 4. C1 0x256/DLC 8 is a different message. Other bytes must be preserved: October-10 also contains 00 80 00 00 without directional input. Resting period is about 250 ms, with event-driven extra reports. Five held inputs precede Race after about 1.2 s. Commit 00b4b99 adds a BH startup selector handler: 200 ms short gestures, 1,800 ms D-to-Race hold refreshed every 250 ms, explicit release and observed intermediate modes. Implementation 50f7604 aligns a new press to fresh neutral input and drained TX, waits one second of actual-mode stability, refreshes held state after incoming factory-neutral reports and holds Race for 2200 ms with 250 ms fallback refresh; suspension retains 150 ms pulses with at most one feedback-gated retry. N/passive does not inject. Owner reported on 2026-10-24 that the beta-29 startup gesture changes the drive mode in the car and other controllers react, so a listener on BH acts on the injected frame; D and Race are confirmed in the vehicle, and so is the injected softer suspension change; the guarded retry path itself was not separately observed. The physical sender is unidentified and this is a single vehicle trial. See docs/research/20261024-startup-gesture-correction.md.

signals.name: suspension_calibration_code
signals.note: Supported mode-dependent raw code: D (b0&0x7C=0x20) 1=Stiff, 0=Soft; Race (0x04) 2=Stiff, 1=Mid. The labelled 20261024-113104Z matrix repeats both softer-to-firm pairs twice and supersedes the Mid=1 inference. Entry briefly carries the prior level for 24–36 ms, so require settled mode/level; N/A=0 is not a Soft command. Unknown combinations remain raw. Manual input/report evidence establishes the layout. Owner-reported vehicle acceptance on 2026-10-24 for the beta-30 source: the configured Race default selects Race and the configured softer suspension setting is applied in the car. This confirms the injected BH 0x256 gestures and the 150 ms suspension pulse. The feedback-gated retry path itself was not separately observed, and no capture or trace accompanies the report. docs/research/20261024-three-session-audit.md
signals.historical_note: D: 1=Stiff after mode entry, 0=Soft after button press, supported by repeated toggles and owner description. Race: 2=Stiff after entry; Mid=1 is a firmware inference requiring a labelled Race-button capture. Unknown values remain raw. See docs/research/20261024-startup-audit.md.

messages.note: Mode presentation with mode-dependent suspension calibration. research_candidates.historical_status: candidate: C1/C2 byte 0 correlates with settled N/A=0x50, D=0x40, Race=0x60 in both captures. Mode-dependent response; no evidence it is a selector command. Existing damping/differential reference interpretation remains unvalidated.

research_candidates.status: supported: Byte 1 is the damper setting and is relative to the drive mode. Entering a mode resets it: D=0x10 hard, Race=0x20 hard, N/A=0x00. The console button then sets D=0x00 (soft) or Race=0x10 (mid) and a second press returns to the mode default; 8/8 presses in 20261024-113104Z, with C1/C2 0x384 byte 6 bit 7 and C1/C2 0x1FC byte 0 mirroring the softened state. The same value 0x10 therefore means D hard and Race mid, so decode it together with the mode. Mode entry carries the previous damper level for 24–36 ms, so settle before decoding; returning from Race to N passes through D as a real intermediate mode. The startup preference injects the rotary direction instead of rewriting this report, and the car applies the configured softer setting.

candidate: Byte 1 is 0x07 during all five Race episodes and 0x9F outside Race in the DNA captures. Existing ACC status decoding uses byte 7; no physical meaning or control-command role is assigned to byte 1.

research_findings.detail: BH 0x46C byte 6 bits 2..1: 0 center, 1 right, 2 left in code and 20260926-182645Z. ON labels in 181818Z show opposite-side values; two left cycles also use right_indicator_off labels. Do not relabel or train automatically.

C1 0x4B1 byte 0 bit 0 follows four marked transitions in 182645Z and four more in 204100Z; 181818Z and two earlier windows contain no matching transition. Comment interpretation is supported across two sessions, not universally validated.
C2 0x1F5 byte 4 raw pressure: 9 of 10 manual brake markers across two sessions match threshold transitions (-3..+1 s). No calibrated pressure unit; lamp blink states are not pedal state.
BH 0x090: 3 complete 0x21 messages in 182645Z and 33 complete 0x06 messages in 185147Z. Bluetooth 0x09 is a current-code test option, not independently captured here.

13 long select/back holds in 185147Z have zero overlapping factory 0x090 RX frames, while BH still receives other frames. This rules out continuous new radio text during those intervals, not a prior overwrite, expired display state or missing BACCAble TX.

IBS 0x41A reports 77..79% in Sept 26-27 sessions and 84% on Sept 28. Positive ECM 0x19BD responses occur in earlier sessions; BCM 0x1005 replies were not decoded in these recordings. Sources must remain distinct.

Historical gap superseded by October-24 rain/wiper field reviews and the labelled DNA/suspension matrix. C2 0x2EC cycle phase, separated AUTO/lamp fields, light-responsive raw channels and mode-dependent suspension reports now have evidence; actuator replay remains a separate acceptance gap. docs/research/20261024-three-session-audit.md
research_findings.historical_detail: No dedicated manual interventions identify rain or wiper signals. C2 0x1FC is reference-only; packet presence does not validate damping codes.

research_findings.detail: Parameter IDs 50..53 are not-implemented catalog entries: request PCI is 2 despite 22+two DID bytes, and their reply offset exceeds the single-frame decoder capacity. This dictionary records the discrepancy; no firmware behavior is changed.

All 20 sessions inventoried (21,354,624 database frames). BH 0x256 direction pulses lead 36 selector-associated mode changes, including all eight N-to-D transitions. One ignition-related D-to-N reset lacks a selector pulse. No cross-bus clock order or physical transmitter identity is inferred. See docs/research/20261023-dna-all-sessions.md

00b4b99 replaces default mode report rewrites with bounded BH 0x256 gestures, keeps slot 38 zero as N/passive, and starts C1 corroboration only after matching BH completion. Owner-reported testing on 2026-10-24 confirms the Race preset and the softer suspension setting in the car; A was not reported separately. See docs/architecture/MENU_UX.md.

C2 0x2EC b2.5 provides a wiper phase; BH 0x354 / C2 0x73E distinguish AUTO selection from dipped indication. BH 0x738 b1/b2 are light-response candidates, not counters. Raw rain intensity and injected lamp control remain unverified. docs/research/20261024-rain-lights-correlation.md

Raw/SQLite content hashes agree on every bus in all three captures; earlier two trace reports reproduce exactly. Race Mid=1 is directly labelled twice; N/A button controls do not change calibration. 0x1FC b0.4 engine-running hypothesis is refuted. Source code feedback mapping matches these states, while automatic startup injection remains unverified. docs/research/20261024-three-session-audit.md

Implementation 50f7604 addresses factory-neutral interference, mode pacing and an ignored suspension pulse with a guarded retry. Host regressions fail against beta-29 source and pass after correction. No new captured signal layout or injected acceptance claim. Owner-reported vehicle acceptance on 2026-10-24 for the beta-30 source: the configured Race default selects Race and the configured softer suspension setting is applied in the car. This confirms the injected BH 0x256 gestures and the 150 ms suspension pulse. The feedback-gated retry path itself was not separately observed, and no capture or trace accompanies the report. Source notes: docs/research/20261024-startup-gesture-correction.md; historical session ledger retains its original source snapshot.

Implementation b22543d9d81768839e90e68b188d90911db88153 adds Settings > Features > Comfort > Rain lights, default OFF. Three C2 0x2EC/DLC8 b2.5 rising phases within 15 seconds request bus-specific 0x73E lamp additions, renewed until 60 seconds after the latest cycle. Requires fresh AUTO and C1/C2 link leases; release stops additions without sending OFF. Physical front/rear lamp acceptance and manual/darkness handover remain unverified. Captured layouts and historical evidence are unchanged. See docs/architecture/MENU_UX.md and docs/ACTION_PLAN.md.

research_findings.topic: Rain-light polling correction and owner-confirmed lamp activation scope
research_findings.detail: Implementation e6159c1537b5b2a412cc2ecb9262190c52946beb fixes rain traffic postponing C2 status/USB polls; a combined production UART/USB/rain regression fails on merged PR #77 and passes after correction. The owner clarified on 2026-10-24 that lamps-on observations used the covered light sensor or physical switch. These physical observations and known lamp payloads are retained: C2 0x73E 00 40 00 40 in AUTO and associated C1 0x73E 02 00 80 00. Rain lights generates those patterns, now checked explicitly in host tests. The remaining unknown is receiver acceptance of additional BACCAble transmissions alongside factory frames, not the observed lamp-state association. Original captures, marker provenance and decoder layouts are unchanged. See docs/research/20261024-rain-light-polling-correction.md.
